## 📋 HOW TO DOWNLOAD FROM POLY PIZZA

1. Go to https://poly.pizza/bundle/City-Pack-kJqRAIGsw0
2. Click "Download GLTF" (recommended) or "Download FBX"
3. Extract the ZIP file
4. Place .glb/.gltf files in your `Traffic/Models/` folder
5. Load in Three.js using GLTFLoader:

```javascript
const loader = new THREE.GLTFLoader();
loader.load('Models/city_pack.glb', (gltf) => {
  scene.add(gltf.scene);
});
```

| **CC-BY** | ✅ Yes (credit creator) | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes |
